invariants.rule: todo-orchestrator SQLite is the sole work-state authority; canonical repository source is the sole code authority. Markdown projections, context packets, worker reports, benchmark summaries, and profiler summaries are evidence only.

invariants.enforcement: compatibility fixtures and full-suite release gate
invariants.rule: Preserve the existing todo-orchestrator, cuda, and cpp-context-compiler public commands, JSON envelopes, normal workflows, and substantive guidance. Additive adapters are preferred over rewrites.

invariants.enforcement: child-token, scope, worktree, and result-contract tests
invariants.rule: Local workers receive bounded child work, isolated writable state, restricted scope, objective gates, and no parent-completion privilege. They do not choose architecture, widen requirements, commit or push user branches, recurse into arbitrary subagents, or treat NEEDS_CODEX as failure.
Optimize Codex-visible tokens, source reads, retries, and tool calls per accepted task. Keep SKILL.md files and routine outputs bounded; prefer deterministic helpers before local-model inference.

Do not download model weights, install large model-serving stacks, alter GPU cabling, or make other substantial external acquisitions without the user. Finish all independent software work, then halt once with an exact acquisition request.

All physical GPU ownership is host-global. Local inference must not coexist with CUDA timing, profiling, topology characterization, or other uncontaminated performance work. Topology is discovered at runtime and is negotiable, not hard-coded.
Run the smallest decisive test or gate while implementing. Run existing full skill suites only at the baseline/software-ready/final checkpoints, not after every edit.
Preserve unrelated user changes. Never reset, clean, overwrite, stage, commit, or attribute paths outside the active task scope without audit.
Treat V100 as compute capability 7.0/sm_70 and use an explicit CUDA 12.x build toolchain for Volta software; never confuse the driver-reported CUDA compatibility level with GPU compute capability.
